MAILGUEST

Support

Get help with addresses, delivery, and inbox access.

A message is missing

Compare the sender’s recipient address to the current MailGuest address. Wait briefly, then select Refresh. If the sender rejects disposable addresses, use an address that its service accepts.

An address expired

Select New address and use the newly generated address. Ask the sender to resend the message to that address.

The provider is unavailable

Keep the existing tab open and try Refresh again. If no address was created, select New address to retry.

Report an issue

Include the browser, device, approximate time, and on-screen error. Keep session tokens, message contents, and personal information out of public reports. Open GitHub Issues ↗
